title: Linear sofic representations of amenable algebras
summary: We study the notion of linear sofic approximations for algebras, analogous to the concept of sofic representations for groups. We prove that for a finitely generated amenable $K$-algebra with no zero divisors, all linear sofic representations are conjugate. This provides an algebraic analogue to Elek and Szabó's theorem for amenable groups. The proof relies on a "linear monotiling" technique, constructed using a theorem by Brešar, Meshulam and Šemrl on locally linearly dependent operators.
